title: Scalably Enhancing the Clinical Validity of a Task Benchmark with Physician Oversight

bias_targets.methodology: Auditing original clinical benchmark labels using an agentic LLM verifier to flag potential errors, independently recomputing labels from clinical notes, and conducting single-blind physician reviews to quantify relative deviations (sMAPE) and agreement rates. The downstream impact of this bias is evaluated by comparing the test accuracy of an LLM fine-tuned via Reinforcement Learning (GRPO) on the original vs. corrected labels.
